text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One afternoon on my day off, I'm
walking by an
outdoor café when I
happen upon a familiar face.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No way...
Trainer
<username>?!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Why, hello there. To think I'd bump into
you here!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I was going to... but the course I want is
only
available for two or more people.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She glances at a signboard that reads,

"All-you-can-eat sweets and pastries!
Perfect for
partners and pals!"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? I don't want to
inconvenience you
just for the sake of
my work...
choice_data_list: If you don't mind me, shall I keep you company?
Shall I join you, if you don't mind me?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Meek told me this café has
amazing
food.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
So I figured that if I could make some for
her, I
could increase her motivation even
further!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As a fellow trainer, I'm impressed by her

dedication, so I decide to help her with
her
"work."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... The parfait cream seems to
emphasize the
richness of the milk over
sweetness.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
But combined with the berry sauce, the
aftertaste
is surprisingly light.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Now for this brûlée cake... Ngh! So rich...
So
sweet...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
With your help, I was able to try all the
dishes I
wanted!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you,
Trainer
<username>!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I think so! I'll give it a try as soon as I get
home.
choice_data_list: Do you think you can make it properly?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Listen! Meek beat her fastest time
yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
She said it was because the desserts I
made really
motivated her. Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
But I still have a long way to go! I need
to keep
researching until I can recreate
the flavors of that
café perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I never want to give Meek anything less
than
top-class support.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: To that end, I'll spare no effort!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer
<username>...
Yes,
absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Trainer Kiryuin shares some of her
homemade
sweets with me as a
thank-you for helping out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I eat them together with
<chrname>.
